definition: יָרַט verb be precipitate, precipitate (transitive) (compare Arabic conjecit, praecipitem dedit in puteum, exitium, Frey .) — Qal Perfect יָרַט Num 22:32 , app. with subject הַדֶּרֶךְ ; the way is precipitate , ( RVm headlong ) before me , but transitive עליֿדי רשׁעים ירטני Job 16:11 into the hands of wicked men he precipitates me (see Di ; יִרְטֵנִי = יִָֽרְטֵנִי ; Baer's text יִרְטֵנִי points to √ רטה q. v.); hence perhaps read יָרַטְתָּ Num 22:32 thou hast precipitated the journey in front of me, i.e. rushed recklessly in front of me; see Di ; Kau AT leaves untransl .

יָרַט verb be precipitate, precipitate (transitive) (compare Arabic conjecit, praecipitem dedit in puteum, exitium, Frey.) —

Qal Perfect יָרַט Num 22:32, app. with subject הַדֶּרֶךְ; the way is precipitate, (RVm headlong) before me, but transitive עליֿדי רשׁעים ירטני Job 16:11 into the hands of wicked men he precipitates me (see Di; יִרְטֵנִי = יִָֽרְטֵנִי; Baer's text יִרְטֵנִי points to √ רטה q. v.); hence perhaps read יָרַטְתָּ Num 22:32 thou hast precipitated the journey in front of me, i.e. rushed recklessly in front of me; see Di; KauAT leaves untransl.
